subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should Feishu direct-session continuity be fixed by retaining direct DM rows, validating/repairing Feishu open_id keys, forcing account-scoped Feishu DMs, or some combination with doctor migration?
rationale: The code evidence supports the failure class, but the safe fix affects retention policy, existing session keys, Feishu plugin identity rules, and possible upgrade repair.

options.title: Design combined retention and repair
options.body: Define TTL-aware direct-DM retention plus Feishu open_id validation/doctor repair so multi-account deployments stop forking sessions without unbounded store growth.

options.title: Force Feishu account-scoped DMs
options.body: Make Feishu DMs use account-scoped keys by default and provide a migration or clear session-continuity break notice.

options.title: Keep workaround only
options.body: Leave per-account-channel-peer as documentation-only mitigation and keep this issue open until stronger live proof narrows the bug.

recommendation.title: Design combined retention and repair
recommendation.body: Define TTL-aware direct-DM retention plus Feishu open_id validation/doctor repair so multi-account deployments stop forking sessions without unbounded store growth.

likelyOwner.reason: The next decision crosses the session maintenance owner boundary, which is central to the reported cascade.
